value.rationale: The invariant is naturally motivated by the recently formulated minimal probabilistic-spectrum question for quasigroups and the broad finite medial Latin class. The theorem classifies all spectrum values uniformly for finite abelian modules (including mixed exponent), gives a sharp iff minimality criterion, and supplies an elementary-divisor formula, rather than an arbitrary small computation. Known affine classification is an input, not the claimed contribution.
